title: Broad MGDA checkpoint dose and preservation boundary audit
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The adverse 16k-to-65k slopes and seed2 preservation miss arise after a coherent earlier checkpoint boundary because 64 updates per 8,192 hands saturate the residual cap; the 32,768-hand dose should retain stronger source agreement and show a more reproducible holdout direction than 65,536.
material_change: Read the exact 24 frozen checkpoints and existing 55,296-trajectory evaluation evidence only. Recompute Standard10 greedy agreement and residual-cap metrics on the same 4,096 balanced states at every 8,192-hand checkpoint. Compute paired per-seed, holdout, and seat slope CIs across 16k-to-32k, 32k-to-65k, and 16k-to-65k using identical deck keys. Identify the last preservation-safe checkpoint and whether halving updates/chunk is evidence-supported. No training or new poker hands.
baseline: At 65,536 hands all 1,536 MGDA steps were positive, but only 1/3 seed 16k-to-65k slopes was positive; seed2 source agreement was 94.5557%, and all seeds reached residual cap 0.25. Final median holdout and seat deltas remained positive.
notes: A lower-update-dose replication is admitted only if the audit locates a pre-65k checkpoint where all three seeds meet >=95% overall and >=90% partition agreement, at least 2/3 seeds have positive paired slope from 16k to that checkpoint, and median holdout/seat breadth is nonnegative. Thresholds are not relaxed after viewing results.

All poker trajectories were reused from the exact SHA-bound 65k run; evaluation_hands remains zero. Paired slope confidence intervals are wide, so admission is based on preregistered multi-seed direction plus preservation/breadth, not a claim that any slope CI excludes zero.

result.summary: The audit verified all 24 checkpoint hashes and 13,824 prior evaluation rows, then made 98,304 frozen source-panel queries. All three seeds were preservation-safe at 32,768 hands; 16k-to-32k pooled holdout slopes were +21.34, +7.33, and -8.54 bb/100, satisfying 2/3 positive. At 32k, median seed-holdout delta was +31.05 and median seed-seat delta +26.86. From 32k to 65k every seed slope turned negative (-42.79,-7.11,-16.81), residual cap saturation began at 24,576-32,768 hands, and seed0/2 crossed the 95% overall boundary at 57,344. All 249 tests passed.
result.conclusion: A coherent optimizer-dose boundary exists: the 32k-equivalent update dose passes all preregistered preservation and breadth gates, whereas the second half of the unchanged 64-step schedule degrades untouched holdouts in 3/3 seeds and exhausts source margin. This is specific evidence for halving updates per chunk at fixed 65k environment hands; it does not justify raising the residual cap or scaling the saturated schedule.
result.next_step: Run the same three seeds, six training identities, three untouched holdouts, 65,536 hands/seed, and evaluation contract with 32 rather than 64 MGDA steps per 8,192-hand chunk. Compare its 65k endpoints to the old 32k-equivalent dose and require 2/3 positive slopes, nonnegative median breadth, and source preservation before any 262k scale.
